actor.description: SpaceCobra is ESET's tracking name for the otherwise-unknown actor behind GravityRAT. ESET attributes the BingeChat and Chatico campaigns to this group and states that the malicious code belongs to the GravityRAT malware family.
actor.analyst_notes: SpaceCobra is a vendor tracking name. GravityRAT is modeled as malware, not as an actor alias.

attribution.assessment: ESET states that the real identity of the actor behind GravityRAT remains unknown; earlier reporting speculated about a Pakistan-based group, but this profile does not elevate that lead into structured attribution.
attribution.analyst_notes: Geographic speculation is retained only in source context, not as a canonical attribution.

diamond_model.adversary: ESET tracking name for the unknown actor behind GravityRAT.
diamond_model.capability: GravityRAT malware family, including Android variants distributed as trojanized messaging applications.
diamond_model.victim: Highly targeted victims; ESET reported a targeted user in India.
diamond_model.analyst_notes: Actor/malware boundary follows ESET and MITRE: SpaceCobra=actor tracking name, GravityRAT=malware.

malware.name: GravityRAT
malware.description: MITRE ATT&CK models GravityRAT as Software S0237. ESET attributes GravityRAT campaigns using BingeChat and Chatico to SpaceCobra.
malware.analyst_notes: Software identity is distinct from the actor tracking name.

targets.selection_logic: Only source-explicit targeting should be structured.
targets.analyst_notes: ESET reported highly targeted activity including a victim in India; no broad country attribution is inferred.

sources.title: Android GravityRAT goes after WhatsApp backups
sources.analyst_notes: Primary actor-scoping source: ESET states the GravityRAT actor remains unknown and is tracked internally as SpaceCobra.

sources.title: GravityRAT, Software S0237
sources.analyst_notes: Used to establish that GravityRAT is malware/software, not a canonical actor.

key_judgments.statement: SpaceCobra is the appropriate actor tracking entity for the ESET-attributed GravityRAT campaigns; GravityRAT itself is malware.

gaps: The real-world identity and organizational affiliation behind SpaceCobra remain unknown.
uncertainties: Vendor tracking scope may not cover every historical GravityRAT deployment.

free_text.executive_summary: SpaceCobraはESETがGravityRAT運用主体を追跡するために用いるActor名。GravityRAT自体はMITRE ATT&CK S0237のMalwareとして分離する。
free_text.history: ESETは2023年、BingeChatおよびChaticoを用いるGravityRATキャンペーンをSpaceCobraへ帰属した。
free_text.capability_details: GravityRATを用いた標的型侵入。Android版ではWhatsAppバックアップ窃取やファイル操作機能が報告されている。
free_text.targeting_details: ESETは高度に標的化された活動として説明し、インドのユーザーへの標的化を報告している。
free_text.additional_notes: 実体組織は不明。Pakistan関連の過去推測を構造化帰属へ昇格しない。
